title: Rain and snow as three depth layers by count, length and speed
note: Rain and snow need three separately tagged depth emitters with rising counts; one system reads as sparse dashes.
intent: A single particle system reads as "sparse short white dashes near camera only" at every density. Build precipitation as three explicitly separate emitters that differ by count, streak length and fall speed — never by scaling one layer up: rain near (0–5 m: streak 0.6–1.0 units, opacity ~0.5, ~200 elements), mid (5–25 m: 0.3–0.5, ~0.3, ~600), far (25 m+: 0.1–0.2, ~0.15, ~1500), with every streak elongated ≥ 6:1 along the fall axis. Snow follows the same layering with a fixed total count (800–1200 flakes) and sprites ≤ 0.05 world units (1–4 px at the default camera, individually visible as warm-lit motes crossing the lamp cone); answer "too sparse / too dense" by adjusting the size range, never by halving the count or inflating sprites into "huge white blobs". All three layers must be simultaneously visible from the primary evaluation camera.

check.js: [['precip-near', 40], ['precip-mid', 150], ['precip-far', 400]].every(([t, min]) => objects(t).reduce((n, o) => n + (o.isInstancedMesh ? o.count : (o.geometry && o.geometry.attributes.position ? o.geometry.attributes.position.count : 1)), 0) >= min)
check.note: Rain/snow has three separately tagged depth emitters with rising counts (near >= 40, mid >= 150, far >= 400; craft numbers 200/600/1500); one system reads as sparse short dashes at any density.

port: Put makePrecip() in the weather module of the atmosphere facet, tag the three emitters precip-near/mid/far, and state count, length, opacity and speed per layer in the brief as a numbered checklist; when snow density is judged wrong, change size range only, and confirm all three layers appear in one screenshot from the primary evaluation camera.

evidence.note: rain near/mid/far: streak 0.6–1.0 / 0.3–0.5 / 0.1–0.2 units, opacity 0.5 / 0.3 / 0.15, ~200 / ~600 / ~1500, ≥6:1 streaks; snow sprites ≤0.05 units, layers differ by count and speed never size
three explicit depth layers (near ~40 within 5 m, mid ~150 at 5–30 m, far ~400 beyond 30 m); snow fixed 800–1200 flakes, adjust size range not count
rain bands near 0–5 m, mid 5–25 m, far 25 m+; per-layer streak length 40/15/5 px and opacity 0.6/0.35/0.15
every weather brief defines exactly 3 named layers with length, opacity, count and fall speed; a single-layer system is an automatic fail; snow 1–4 px at the default camera
blue-hour checklist (c): flakes individually visible as small warm-lit motes crossing the lamp cone, not a uniform wash or sparse speckle
